known_issues: The engine suite runs one second after world post-init in a fresh dedicated server with no connected player; timers, announcements, net state and client replication named in accept-5 are never observed.

Catalog 2.1.0: the exam publishes the result fields and the four status strings, says that Open accepts any well-formed server proposal, that deadlines are on the GetTime() clock and that a server-side Close settles at once. The deadline case now requires the passed/on result instead of any two equal results, and the snapshot case checks the mutated ballot itself. The three former strict-reading alternatives violate published rules and are target-negatives.
